description: Mixpanel: declares its REAL capabilities. Vocabulary discovery and historical import — no live stream. Replaces the mocked connector in whisperr-watch/src/services/integrations.ts.

cases.name: vocabulary_discovery
cases.proves: 02: the connector's real primary value — telling the customer what they already track

expect.notes: Mixpanel tells Whisperr which events exist so the setup checklist can propose mappings. This is capability, not coverage.

cases.name: historical_import_reaches_validated_only
cases.proves: 08: history:true reaches validated and carries the historical label

cases.name: never_reports_live_coverage
cases.proves: 08: a historical-only connection can NEVER reach live

expect.notes: live_stream is false in the manifest, so no code path may set this capability to live. This is the honesty rule (02, rule 4) — Mixpanel imports are not real-time and are never displayed as though they were.

cases.name: no_live_stream_capability_claimed
cases.proves: 02: a capability with no demonstrating fixture cannot be declared true

expect.notes: CI cross-checks: capabilities.live_stream is false and NO case demonstrates it. A true here with no demonstrating case fails the build.

cases.name: imported_identity_resolves_only
cases.proves: 03: analytics ids resolve, they never create

cases.name: import_creates_no_consent
cases.proves: 04: an imported record is not an imported permission

expect.notes: basis:imported_record applies to migrated CONSENT records with a pointer to the original. An analytics property containing an address is not one.

cases.name: labels_only_shed_mode
cases.proves: C2: the pre-agreed scope-shed is a first-class supported mode, not a hack

expect.notes: Shed step 2 sets history:false too, leaving capability declaration with no ingestion. The connector still validates against this same fixture file.
